messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy: release=v0.12.3 region=eu-west-1 window=23:00-01:00 UTC tag=surge-fallback. Rolling to 3 AZs, will ramp traffic over 6 minutes. Will emit status updates here.

maya.su: thanks. can someone draft the short customer-facing blurb for Statuspage and a one-paragraph email we can reuse? need to send ~30m before window.

jack.tang: quick tech note: we've pinned runtime to inference-runtime@2.4.0 for this rollout to avoid a kernel churn we saw in canaries. if error rate >1.5% for 5m we auto-rollback.

aaron.kaplan: confirmed runtime pin. also adding a temporary fallback route to hosted-legacy for customer requests if latency >600ms p95 for 3 consecutive mins.

olivia.ramos: draft for status page: "Scheduled maintenance: rolling inference runtime update in eu-west-1. Some requests may see increased latency for up to 10 minutes while we finish traffic ramp. No data loss expected. We'll update when complete." happy to tighten.

maya.su: love that. can we get a 2-line email snippet for CS to paste?

olivia.ramos: email snippet: "Heads up — we're releasing an update to our inference runtime in eu-west-1 tonight (23:00–01:00 UTC). You may experience brief increases in latency during the rollout. If you rely on strict latency SLAs, reply to this thread and we’ll help schedule a reserved window. — Redwood Inference"

jack.tang: ops checklist reminder: 1) pin model/weights to v7-quant if fallback triggers; 2) ensure KV cache warm starts on new pods; 3) monitor token error rate and model quality alerts.

sre-oncall: rollback criteria added to the thread: error_rate >= 1.5% for 5m OR sustained p95 latency >= 800ms for 5m -> trigger rollback to previous deployment, notify customers via Statuspage incident and CS broadcast. if rollback happens, run postmortem with incident tags: release, eu-west-1, surge-fallback.

maya.su: OK pulling this into the comms doc. putting the Statuspage snippet below (please review):

```
Statuspage component: EU-West inference runtime
Impact: Users in EU-West may see brief latency increases during a scheduled deployment window.
Scheduled maintenance: 23:00 - 01:00 UTC
Updates: We'll post progress and resolution here. If you experience errors beyond brief spikes, contact support@redwood.ai or reply to your account team's thread.
```

aaron.kaplan: small tweak: add "No request data is deleted or altered during this update" to reduce customer worry.

olivia.ramos: updated status text: "No request data is deleted or altered during this update. We expect normal service within 10 minutes of the window close."

jack.tang: operational note for Support: if customers ask about version pinning, say: "We pinned the runtime for this rollout to 2.4.0 to ensure stability; we'll provide upgrade notes after the rollout completes."

maya.su: final to-send Statuspage snippet (CS-approved):

"Scheduled maintenance — EU-West inference runtime
Time: 23:00–01:00 UTC
Impact: Some requests may experience brief latency increases while we perform a rolling runtime update. No request data will be deleted or altered. Normal service expected within ~10 minutes after the window closes.
Updates will be posted here. For critical SLA concerns, reply to your account contact or email support@redwood.ai."

sre-oncall: I'll post the incident if rollback triggers and ping @eng-oncall and @product. I'll also capture metrics snapshot before and after (latency, error rate, token throughput).

deploy-bot: Deploy started: batch 1/6. Rolling. Monitoring hooks active.

maya.su: schedule note: sending out the customer email at 22:30 UTC. tagging CS queue.

jack.tang: batch 3/6: small bump in p95 (470ms) but still below threshold. KV warm start completed on new nodes.

aaron.kaplan: adding temporary ingress token throttle at the edge in case of surge.

deploy-bot: Deploy progressed: batch 6/6 complete. Final health checks OK. No rollback triggered.

olivia.ramos: posting statuspage update: "Maintenance complete — EU-West inference runtime. All services normal. If you see residual latency, try clearing session caches or reach out."

maya.su: thanks everyone. saving comms templates to the shared drive under "releases/customer-comms/2024-11-surgefallback" and closing thread.
